q1.question: What is Vidu Q3 Image to Video?
q1.answer: Vidu Q3 Image to Video converts your uploaded images into video clips with customizable movement amplitude, duration, and audio options.

q2.question: What is movement amplitude?
q2.answer: Movement amplitude controls how much motion appears in your video. Choose auto for automatic detection, or select small, medium, or large for specific intensity levels.

q3.question: Can I add background music?
q3.answer: Yes. You can enable the background music option to add music to your generated videos.

q4.question: What video durations are supported?
q4.answer: Vidu Q3 supports video durations from 1 to 16 seconds. Use the slider or input field to set your desired length.

q5.question: What resolutions are available?
q5.answer: You can choose from 540p, 720p, or 1080p resolutions depending on your quality and file size preferences.
